daughter.name: Daughter
daughter.part: the miner’s daughter, now an astronomer

about: A miner’s daughter becomes an astronomer. After his loss of sight, she brings the stars back to his palm.

lines.zh: 你回家的时候，天已经黑了
lines.py: nǐ huí jiā de shí hòu， tiān yǐ jīng hēi le
lines.en: When you came home, the sky was already dark
lines.id: Saat Ayah pulang, langit sudah gelap

lines.py: méi huī hái liú zài nǐ de zhǐ fèng
lines.en: Coal dust still clung between your fingers
lines.id: Debu batu bara masih melekat di sela jarimu

lines.zh: 你把我的小手轻轻摊开
lines.py: nǐ bǎ wǒ de xiǎo shǒu qīng qīng tān kāi
lines.en: You gently opened my little hand

lines.zh: 一笔一画，画出一片星空
lines.py: yī bǐ yī huà， huà chū yī piàn xīng kōng
lines.en: Stroke by stroke, you drew a sky full of stars
lines.id: Gores demi gores, kaulukis langit penuh bintang

lines.zh: 你说每颗星，都有自己的故事
lines.py: nǐ shuō měi kē xīng， dōu yǒu zì jǐ de gù shì
lines.en: You said every star had a story of its own
lines.id: Katamu, tiap bintang punya kisahnya sendiri

lines.zh: 我听着听着，就睡进了梦中
lines.py: wǒ tīng zhe tīng zhe， jiù shuì jìn le mèng zhōng
lines.en: I listened until I drifted into dreams
lines.id: Aku mendengarkan hingga terlelap dalam mimpi

lines.zh: 你说爸爸的路，在山的深处
lines.py: nǐ shuō bà bà de lù， zài shān de shēn chù
lines.en: You said, Dad’s road runs deep into the mountain
lines.id: Katamu, jalan Ayah jauh di dalam gunung

lines.zh: 你的路，要走向有光的地方
lines.py: nǐ de lù， yào zǒu xiàng yǒu guāng de dì fāng
lines.en: Yours must lead towards the light
lines.id: Jalanmu harus menuju tempat yang terang

lines.py: nǐ gěi wǒ de xīng kōng
lines.en: The starry sky you gave me

lines.py: liàng zài wǒ měi yí gè mèng zhōng
lines.en: Shines through every dream I have

lines.py: nǐ zài méi yǒu xīng guāng de dì fāng
lines.en: In a place without starlight

lines.py: tuō qǐ wǒ tóu dǐng de cāng qióng
lines.en: You held up the heavens above my head

lines.py: bà bà a， wò jǐn wǒ de shǒu
lines.en: Dad, hold my hand tightly

lines.py: jiù xiàng nà nián wò zhe wǒ
lines.en: As you held mine back then

lines.py: nǐ céng huà gěi wǒ de xīng kōng
lines.en: The sky you once drew for me

lines.py: ràng wǒ màn màn jiǎng gěi nǐ tīng
lines.en: Let me tell you about it, slowly

lines.zh: 那场塌方以后，灯还亮着
lines.py: nà chǎng tā fāng yǐ hòu， dēng hái liàng zhe
lines.en: After the mine collapsed, the light was still on
lines.id: Setelah tambang runtuh, lampunya masih menyala

lines.zh: 你却再也看不见我的脸
lines.py: nǐ què zài yě kàn bú jiàn wǒ de liǎn
lines.en: But you could no longer see my face
lines.id: Namun Ayah tak lagi dapat melihat wajahku

lines.zh: 我说，爸爸，我不去念书了
lines.py: wǒ shuō， bà bà， wǒ bù qù niàn shū le
lines.en: I said, Dad, I’m not going away to study
lines.id: Kataku, Ayah, aku tak jadi pergi kuliah

lines.zh: 你把录取信放回我手边
lines.py: nǐ bǎ lù qǔ xìn fàng huí wǒ shǒu biān
lines.en: You put my acceptance letter back beside my hand
lines.id: Kauletakkan lagi surat penerimaan itu di sisi tanganku

lines.zh: 后来我有了第一架望远镜
lines.py: hòu lái wǒ yǒu le dì yī jià wàng yuǎn jìng
lines.en: Later, I had my first telescope

lines.zh: 你学着用手杖走过长街
lines.py: nǐ xué zhe yòng shǒu zhàng zǒu guò cháng jiē
lines.en: You learned to cross the long street with a cane
lines.id: Ayah belajar menyusuri jalan dengan tongkat

lines.zh: 毕业那天，我把证书交给你
lines.py: bì yè nà tiān， wǒ bǎ zhèng shū jiāo gěi nǐ
lines.en: On graduation day, I placed my certificate in your hands
lines.id: Saat wisuda, kuserahkan ijazahku ke tanganmu

lines.zh: 那枚钢印，你摸了好多遍
lines.py: nà méi gāng yìn， nǐ mō le hǎo duō biàn
lines.en: You felt its embossed seal again and again

lines.zh: 我认得天上越来越多的星
lines.py: wǒ rèn de tiān shàng yuè lái yuè duō de xīng
lines.en: I learned more and more of the stars above
lines.id: Makin banyak bintang di langit yang kukenal

lines.zh: 你听我说着，一颗一颗地记
lines.py: nǐ tīng wǒ shuō zhe， yī kē yī kē dì jì
lines.en: You listened and remembered them, one by one
lines.id: Kaudengarkan dan kauingat satu per satu

lines.py: nǐ gěi wǒ de xīng kōng
lines.en: The starry sky you gave me

lines.py: liàng zài wǒ měi yí gè mèng zhōng
lines.en: Shines through every dream I have

lines.py: nǐ zài méi yǒu xīng guāng de dì fāng
lines.en: In a place without starlight

lines.py: tuō qǐ wǒ tóu dǐng de cāng qióng
lines.en: You held up the heavens above my head

lines.py: bà bà a， wò jǐn wǒ de shǒu
lines.en: Dad, hold my hand tightly

lines.py: jiù xiàng nà nián wò zhe wǒ
lines.en: As you held mine back then

lines.py: nǐ céng huà gěi wǒ de xīng kōng
lines.en: The sky you once drew for me

lines.py: ràng wǒ màn màn jiǎng gěi nǐ tīng
lines.en: Let me tell you about it, slowly

lines.py: jīn yè qún xīng， màn màn liàng qǐ
lines.en: Tonight, the stars slowly light up

lines.py: zuì hǎo de zuò wèi， liú gěi le nǐ
lines.en: The best seat is reserved for you

lines.py: rén men wèi zhè piàn xīng kōng gǔ zhǎng
lines.en: People applaud this sky full of stars
lines.id: Orang-orang bertepuk tangan untuk langit ini

lines.py: nǐ wèn wǒ， tā men yǒu duō míng liàng
lines.en: You ask me how brightly they shine
lines.id: Kautanya kepadaku, seberapa terang bintang-bintang itu

lines.py: zhǎng shēng sàn le， zuò wèi dōu kōng le
lines.en: The applause fades; every other seat is empty
lines.id: Tepuk tangan reda, kursi-kursi lainnya telah kosong

lines.zh: 我关掉群星，坐回你身旁
lines.py: wǒ guān diào qún xīng， zuò huí nǐ shēn páng
lines.en: I switch off the stars and sit beside you again
lines.id: Kumatikan bintang-bintang, lalu duduk lagi di sisimu

lines.py: nǐ gěi wǒ de xīng kōng
lines.en: The starry sky you gave me

lines.py: liàng zài wǒ měi yí gè mèng zhōng
lines.en: Shines through every dream I have

lines.py: nǐ zài méi yǒu xīng guāng de dì fāng
lines.en: In a place without starlight

lines.py: tuō qǐ wǒ tóu dǐng de cāng qióng
lines.en: You held up the heavens above my head

lines.py: bà bà a， wò jǐn wǒ de shǒu
lines.en: Dad, hold my hand tightly

lines.py: zhè yī cì， huàn wǒ qiān zhe nǐ zǒu
lines.en: This time, let me lead you
lines.id: Kali ini, biarkan aku yang menuntunmu

lines.py: nǐ céng huà gěi wǒ de xīng kōng
lines.en: The sky you once drew for me

lines.py: jīn yè yòu zài nǐ shǒu zhōng
lines.en: Tonight, that sky is in your hands again
lines.id: Malam ini, langit itu kembali di tanganmu

lines.zh: 我摊开你那双苍老的手
lines.py: wǒ tān kāi nǐ nà shuāng cāng lǎo de shǒu
lines.en: I open your two aged hands
lines.id: Kubuka kedua tanganmu yang telah menua

lines.py: yī kē yī kē， huà gěi nǐ
lines.en: Star by star, I draw for you
lines.id: Satu per satu, kulukiskan bintang untukmu

lines.py: bà bà， zhè kē xīng de gù shì
lines.en: Dad, the story of this star—

lines.py: wǒ men màn màn shuō
lines.en: We can tell it slowly
